name: DaisyRose-27B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: Gated DeltaNet linear attention with full gated attention every 4th layer (16 of 64); partial RoPE
notes: ADDED 2026-11-19. An RL-only post-train of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (no SFT, no distillation), not a new base model: same config.json, same 27.781B parameters (identical tensor set; card breaks this into a 0.46B vision encoder + 0.42B multi-token-prediction head kept unchanged from the base). Trained on ~1,200 curated long-horizon agent tasks (sessions up to 1M tokens) for 18 days on 144 H200s (~63,000 GPU-hours) with RadixArk's Miles async RL framework. Recorded as a contender because its card prints a base-vs-tuned table where its own column beats the base on 6 same-test rows (Terminal Bench 2.1, DeepSWE v1.1, SWE Bench Pro v2, HLE text-only, IFBench, GPQA Diamond); the evidence rows are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-11-18. HARDWARE GATE: dense, active_params_b = params_b = 27.781 (card 'Activated parameters 27B'); params_b x 0.5 GiB = 13.9 GiB <= 128 and active 27.781 <= 40, so it passes. Hybrid Gated DeltaNet stack keeps per-token KV on only 16 of 64 layers (kv_cache_bytes_per_token 65536 = 16 full layers x 4 kv heads x 256 head_dim x 2 (K+V) x 2 bytes fp16), so long-context KV growth is bounded like the base. Card weights: ~52 GB BF16 / 29 GB FP8 / 23 GB NVFP4 (NVFP4 needs Blackwell); runs on a single RTX PRO 6000 / RTX 5090 / DGX Spark. HONESTY CAVEATS: (1) the headline 'Terminal Bench 4.1 5.6 -> 12.0' is CROSS-VERSION - the card's own sources note says the base 5.6 is a Terminal Bench 4.0 score (Artificial Analysis, xhigh) shown in a 4.1 row because the base has no 4.1 entry; that row is flagged in its config and is not a same-test win. (2) DaisyRose scores are the HIGHER of its BF16 and FP8 runs (card says they differ by <1 point wherever both ran). (3) It LOSES to larger models in the same table - MiMo V2.6 Flash and Inkling 2 Small beat it on Terminal Bench 2.1/4.1, DeepSWE, HLE and GPQA; Inkling also beats it on SWE Bench Pro v2. The wins are over its own 27B base and same-size peers (Muse Glimmer-30B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), not over the flash-class leaders.

benchmarks.name: Terminal Bench 2.1
benchmarks.config: Card table, column 'DaisyRose-27B' vs base column 'Qwen3.8-27B' 73.0 (+2.5). Base number is the vendor's own bf16 run from the Qwen3.8-27B model card (Terminus 2 harness); DaisyRose averaged over 5 repetitions per task, Terminus 2 harness. DaisyRose runs use the base's recommended thinking-mode defaults: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, min_p 0, reasoning effort xhigh (the template default), no max_tokens cap within 256K context. Card states DaisyRose scores are the higher of its BF16 and FP8 runs (differ by <1 point wherever both were run). LOSES to MiMo V2.6 Flash 87.6 and Inkling 2 Small 81.3 in the same table.

benchmarks.name: DeepSWE v1.1
benchmarks.config: Card table, DaisyRose 46.2 vs base Qwen3.8-27B 42.2 (+4.0). Base number from the Qwen3.8-27B model card (vendor bf16 run, mini-swe-agent harness); DaisyRose averaged over 8 repetitions per task, mini-swe-agent harness. Thinking-mode defaults as in the Terminal Bench 2.1 row; higher of BF16/FP8 runs. LOSES to MiMo V2.6 Flash 67.9, Inkling 2 Small 72.1, Muse Spark Open 60.0 and GPT-6 Luna 66.6 in the same table.

benchmarks.name: SWE Bench Pro v2
benchmarks.config: Card table, DaisyRose 94.7 vs base Qwen3.8-27B 91.3 (+3.4). Base column is NOT a card run: it is the Base row of Table 3 in arXiv 2611.16289 (full 642-task set, mini-swe-agent), as the card's sources note states. DaisyRose averaged over 5 repetitions per task, mini-swe-agent harness; thinking-mode defaults; higher of BF16/FP8 runs. LOSES to Inkling 2 Small 97.7 and Muse Spark Open 95.0 in the same table; MiMo V2.6 Flash, Beam 1.0 and GPT-6 Luna report only the Hard subset so are not comparable on this row.

benchmarks.name: HLE (text only)
benchmarks.config: Card table, DaisyRose 34.3 vs base Qwen3.8-27B 33.9 (+0.4, small delta). Base column is Artificial Analysis' measurement of Qwen3.8-27B at xhigh (third-party, not a vendor bf16 card run). DaisyRose averaged over 5 repetitions per problem, GPT-6 Luna grader, no tools; thinking-mode defaults; higher of BF16/FP8 runs. Variant note: the catalog's qwen3-8-27b record carries HLE 30.8 from the Qwen card table, a different HLE variant than this text-only/no-tools row. LOSES to Inkling 2 Small 44.1, Muse Spark Open 43.9, GPT-6 Luna 38.5 and MiMo V2.6 Flash 35.1 in the same table.

benchmarks.name: IFBench
benchmarks.config: Card table, DaisyRose 82.4 vs base Qwen3.8-27B 79.5 (+2.9); best score in this row of the card table. Base number from the Qwen3.8-27B model card (vendor bf16 run). DaisyRose averaged over 4 repetitions per prompt (300 prompts), official allenai/IFBench scorer, prompt-level loose accuracy on the final response (thinking excluded); thinking-mode defaults; higher of BF16/FP8 runs.

benchmarks.name: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.config: Card table, DaisyRose 90.7 vs base Qwen3.8-27B 89.2 (+1.5). Base number from the Qwen3.8-27B model card (vendor bf16 run). DaisyRose averaged over 8 repetitions per question (198 questions), simple-evals multiple-choice template and answer extraction, answer order reshuffled each repetition; thinking-mode defaults; higher of BF16/FP8 runs. LOSES to Inkling 2 Small 93.0 in the same table.

benchmarks.name: Terminal Bench 4.1
benchmarks.config: Card table row 'Terminal Bench 4.1': DaisyRose 12.0 vs base column 5.6, and the card prose claims 'Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 rises from 5.6 to 12.0'. CAVEAT: the card's own sources note says models without a 4.1 entry show Terminal Bench 4.0 scores instead, and lists Qwen3.8-27B (xhigh, Artificial Analysis) among them - so the 5.6 base value is a TB 4.0 score, NOT a same-test 4.1 baseline. DaisyRose side: averaged over 8 repetitions per task, internal mini-swe-agent harness with summarization enabled; thinking-mode defaults; higher of BF16/FP8 runs. LOSES to MiMo V2.6 Flash 16.1, GPT-6 Luna 15.2 and Inkling 2 Small 13.0 in the same row.
